title: Either Or Check
description: Read an integer x and print YES when x is exactly 5 or exactly 10, otherwise print NO. This is a targeted remedial probe for C2-M01 (boolean-operator-confusion): writing `x == 5 or 10` makes the condition always truthy, so the negative boundary cases distinguish genuine two-sided comparison reasoning from truthy-or reasoning. Like every EvidencePack, a failure here is observed evidence that can help diagnosis, never a deterministic detection on its own.
output_format: A single line: YES or NO.
